title: Consume European Firaga CCEC indirect record
changes: Extend the indirect-record resource with the authenticated eight-byte CCEC record while preserving prior records, the indexed pointer, literal root and guest fallback.
validation: Wine reader e361-firaga-ccec-indirect-readers-wine-zcuhebx4 verifies 20 original interpreter/generated cases, prior representation and 145 unchanged resources, separate pointer/root owners, boundaries and snapshot ownership.
Wine scene e361-firaga-ccec-indirect-scene-wine-_jvgs94x consumes the record across 606 altered-source frames while state, guest clock, video, OAM, dispatch and five audio streams match.

Wine CLI e361-firaga-ccec-indirect-cli-wine-z4yf7_da creates, reuses and verifies 147 matching files; static join e361-firaga-ccec-indirect-sample-residual-idrflo71 leaves zero unowned addresses in the selected E302 sample.
limitations: The address-only sample does not establish individual PCs or prove conditional ancestry. Other indices, callers, scenes, source-save history, real BIOS, UI save/Load and full-ROM coverage remain open.
Older revision-sensitive Wine fixtures need adaptation and rerun; Linux, USA and native Windows remain pending. No performance comparison was made.
